t: Din shebitat hayyachid vekelayv umahalak alpayim amma
s: Din shebitat hayyachid vekelayv umahalak alpayim amma ubo k' seipim: kol adam yesh lo chutz mid' ammot o mehammaqom sheshshabat bo alpayim amma lekol ruach, merubbaot ketabla merubbaat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"t:

Qiddesh alayv hayyom babbiqa harcheq min hair, sheen sham techume shabbat mesummanim veeno yodea leshaer techum shabbat — mehallek alpayim pesiot benoniyyot kederek halikato shel adam, vezehu techum shabbat, ki derek halikato shel adam amma merosh gudal regel zo ad rosh gudal regel zo, shemmarchiq kachatzi amma ben regel leregel. Umeqom matztzab haregel im hamminal hu gam ken kachatzi amma:

Keshem sheen adam rashshay lehallek beshabbat veyom tob ella alpayim amma lekol ruach chutz limqom shebitato, kak kelayv ubehemto en yekolim shum adam leholikam chutz lealpayim shel baalehem, mippene sheqqanu shebita bimqom shebitat baalehem, ap al pi shello hayu sham kesheqqiddesh hayyom. Veim erebu baalehem leruach achat — en shum adam yakol leholikam leruach haacheret apillu pesia achat bemaqom sheen habbealim yekolim lehallek:

Hammoser behemto libno, hare hi keragle haab, sheen shum adam yakol leholikah ella bemaqom shehaab yakol lehallek velo bemaqom shehabben yakol lehallek, ap al pi shemmesarah lo mibbeod yom, lepi shedderek bene adam lehapqid cheptzehem beyad benehem veen kavvanatam limsor birshutam:

Abal hammoser behemto leroeh, apillu mesarah lo beyom tob velo mibbeod yom — hare hi keragle haroeh, ben shehu yisrael ben shehu nokri, lepi shemmin hassetam gam meetmol haya bedato lemosrah lo hayyom, veqonta shebita bimqom shebitat haroeh vaapillu hu nokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"a. Veim mesarah leb' roim — hare hi keragle bealeha, mippene shello qana echad mehem. Vaapillu im mesarah lishnehem meereb yom tob velo berer debarayv, ubeyom tob berer debarayv shemmesarah leechad mehem, veelayv nitkavven meereb yom tob — ap al pi ken kevan shebbeshaa sheqqiddesh hayyom lo haya meborar adayin leezeh mehem mesarah, lo qanu shenehem, venishara birshut habbealim velaken hi keraglayv:

Shor shel roeh — keragle anshe otah hair, sheapillu ereb haroeh leruach achat eno meakkeb al echad mibbene otah hair shellaqechu mimmennu beyom tob milleholiko alpayim leruach haacheret, mippene shemmeetmol maamido birshut bene hair, lepi shergilim liqqach mimmennu. Abal im echad meir acheret sheereb leir zo laqechu mimmennu beyom tob — eno yakol leholiko leiro:

Abal shor shel pattam hu keragle mi shelleqacho leshochoto beyom tob, apillu hu meir acheret. Veken im shechato bealayv beyom tob umakar besaro — hare kol echad mehalloqechim molik manato lemaqom shehu holek, apillu hu meir acheret, mippene sheddaat bealayv lemokro gam laanashim acherim chutz meanshe otah hair, mippene shehu meputtam vehakkol shomeim shimo ubaim liqnoto:
Kelim hamyuchadim leechad mehaachim shebbabbayit — hare hem keraglayv, vesheenam meyuchadim — enam yekolim leholikam ella lemaqom shekkullam yekolim lehallek:

Shenayim sheshshaalu meereb yom tob chaluq echad, zeh lelek bo yom tob shacharit vezeh lelek bo arbit — hare hu keragle shenehem, dehaynu sheen yekolim leholiko ella lemaqom sheshshenehem yekolim lehallek. Veim ereb zeh lesop alpayim lemizrach, vezeh lesop alpayim lemaarab — lo yezizuhu mimmeqom shebitatam, shehare zeh sheereb lemizrach eno yakol lehallek lemaarab mimmeqom shebitato apillu pesia achat, vezeh sheereb lemaarab eno yakol lelek lemizrach apillu pesia achat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"ch:

B' shellaqechu behema beshuttaput ushechatuha beyom tob, ap al pi shechalaquha velaqechu kol echad manato — hare kol habbasar shel zeh vezeh keragle shenehem, lepi shebben hashshemashot yanaq kol echad mechabero keshehayeta habbehema bechayyeha. Abal im laqechu chabit shel yayin beshuttaput meereb yom tob, vachalaquha beyom tob — hare chelqo shel kol echad mehem keraglayv, lepi shebbeshel dibrehem yesh berera, dehaynu sheanu omerim shehubrar haddabar lemaprea shezzeh haya chelqo hammaggia lo meereb yom tob, veqana shebita bimqom shebitato:

Hashshoel keli mechabero meereb yom tob, apillu lo laqechu ad hallayla, hare hu keragle hashshoel, shekkevan sheamar lo mibbeod yom lehashilo — heemido birshuto sheyyolikennu lemaqom sheyyirtzeh. Abal im shealo mimmennu beyom tob — hare hu keragle hammashil. Vaapillu darko leshoolo mimmennu bekol yom tob, en omerim shemmeetmol heemido birshuto, lepi shekkevan shello ba leshoolo mimmennu meereb yom tob, sabur hammashil shemma metzao adam acher shehishil lo velo yishal mimmennu:

Haishsha sheshshaala mechabertah beyom tob mayim o melach leissatah utebalin liqderatah — hare haissa vehattabshil keragle shettehen, veen omerim sheyibbatelu hammayim umelach beissa, mippene shehu dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin. Veap al pi sheddabar sheyyesh lo mattirin eno batel ella bemin shennitareb bemino, abal besheeno mino batel hu ap al pi sheyyesh lo mattirin, mikkol maqom kevan shehammayim umelach baim letaqqen haissa, hare hem immah kemin bemino leinyan zeh:
Laqach mechabero beyom tob gachelet, lo yolikenna ella keragle hannoten. Abal im hidliq ner o etz shello mishshalhebet chabero — hare hu keragle zeh shehidliq:

Bor shel yachid — hare hu keragle bealim, veshel otah hair — keragle anshe otah hair. Veim mi shehu meir acheret ba umille immahem — eno molikam ella keragle anshe otah hair, dehaynu alpayim lekol ruach, im kullam lo erebu. Veim echad mehair ereb letzapon veechad ledarom — zeh molik letzapon keraglayv vezeh ledarom keraglayv, shehare hem shuttapim babbor, veyesh berera, kemo shennitbaer bechabit shel yayin (bisip y). Abal im mi shehu meir acheret ba umille mehem leatzmo — lo yezizem mimmeqom shebitatam im zeh ereb lesop alpayim letzapon vezeh lesop alpayim ledarom, shehare mayim ellu hem lo keragle shenehen, sheggam mishshellahem hu memalle. Veen shayyak lomar bo "yesh berera", kevan sheen lo cheleq kelal bebor zeh. Abal im echad mibbene hair mille venatan lo — molikan keragle hamemalle, shehare mechelqo mille venatan lo, sheyyesh berera. Ubor shel hepqer — keragle hamemalle rishon, sheap shello qanu hammayim shum shebita beben hashshemashot, shecheptze hepqer enam qonim shebita, mikkol maqom keshebba zeh umille, vezaka bemah shemmille min hahepqer — hare qanu az shebita kishbitato:

Vekol zeh bemayim mekunnasim shehem qevuyim veomedim, kegon me geshamim. Abal neharot hammoshekim, ap al pi sheenam nobeim, hoil vehem nadim venaim — lo qanu shebita apillu hem shel yachid. Veken mayanot hannobeim, veap al pi sheen yotzein mimmeqom nebiatam limmashek lehalea, hoil veenam nachim — lo qanu shebita apillu hem shel yachid. Ulepikak hem keragle hamemalle rishon, sheaz qanu shebita kishbitato, kevan shennipsequ az mimmeqom nebiutam o mimmeqom hillukam:
Hayu baim michutz lattechum letok hattechum — memalleim mehem beshabbat, veen tzarik lomar beyom tob, hoil velo qanu shebita kelal chutz lattechum:

Geshamim hayyoredim beyom tob betok techum hair — hem keragle anshe otah hair, vekol shekken kesheyyaredu letok hair atzmah, mippene shello qanu shebita beuqeyanus o beabim, hoil vehem nadim venaim sham:

Mille mayim mibbor shel hepqer letzorek chabero — hem keragle hamemalleim. Veap al pi shebbishat hammilluy zaka bahem chabero, shehammagbiah metzia lachabero qana chabero, mikkol maqom zekiyya zo enah ella mishshum sheim haya rotzeh haya zokeh bahem leatzmo, yakol lizkot bahem gam ken lachabero. Vekevan shello zaka ella mikkocho — hare hem keraglayv:

Mi shehayu lo perot mupqadim beir acheret shechutz lattechum, veerebu bene otah hair labo etzlo — lo yabiu lo mipperotayv, shepperotayv kamohu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannipqad yiched lo qeren zavit, sheamar lo "hannichem bezavit zo", sheaz lo qibbel alayv shemiratan kelal, raq kavvanato hi "hare beti lepaneka, hannach leka bezaviyyot zo ushemor leka" (veen tzarik lomar im amar lo beperush "hinneh habbayit lepaneka, hannach leka bemaqom shettirtzeh" — shello qibbel alayv shemiratan kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer bechoshen mishpat simman ratz"[a]). Abal im keshehipqidam etzlo qibbelam mimmennu setam — hare qibbel alayv shemiratan vahare hem keraglayv, kevan shehem mesurim beyado leshomran:
Mi shezzimmen etzlo orechim beyom tob — lo yoliku beyadam manot lemaqom sheen baal hasseudda yakol lelek, ella im ken zikka lahem bemanot ellu al yede acher meereb yom tob:
